segments.name: Lease-to-own
segments.description: Provides a technology-driven lease-to-own platform that lets underserved U.S. nonprime consumers obtain durable goods from omnichannel and e-commerce retailers.
segments.evidence: The Company is a single segment business, which provides lease payment options to consumers to obtain durable goods from omnichannel and e-commerce partners.

revenueModel.text: Consumers pay Katapult recurring lease payments under lease-purchase agreements for durable goods, which is the company's primary source of revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: Katapult's primary source of revenue is generated from recurring payment streams related to our contracted lease payments with consumers.
